hypothesis: Inherited legacy exposure concentrates risk; a causal benchmark-relative volatility ceiling may reduce drawdown and CVaR. No presumption of excess return improvement.
signal: Same-cost frozen shadow legacy prior-close signal_exposure plus signed requested_shares * close / signal_account. Buy is positive; sell negative; no intent means zero increment. No actual candidate holdings feed back into shadow engine.
risk_cap: min(1, trailing60 sample_std(SOXX close returns)/trailing60 sample_std(SOXL close returns)); min(raw intended weight, risk_cap). Full prior data only, next canonical open execution. Rolling risk is a proxy, not a pathwise tail guarantee.
design: Only capped is candidate. Raw intended weight is matched execution control; original frozen legacy, static50SOXL and SOXX are references. No winner selection after results.
execution: Integer adjusted-price research shares, daily next-open target rebalance, exact proportional cost cash funding, native Qlib Exchange/Account/Position primary with independent ledger reconciliation; no borrowed cash, no terminal liquidation, cash zero yield.

gates.development: Both costs: positive net log excess vs SOXX; at least6/7positive years; median annual excess>0; MaxDD and CVaR5 no worse SOXX; both20/60block bootstrap95% lower>0.
gates.risk_repair: Report cap-minus-raw control and cap-minus-original drawdown, CVaR and return tradeoff; no weakened excess gate.
gates.promotion: No promotion regardless of diagnostic result: historical reuse and no fresh forward/PIT execution evidence.

diagnostics: Frozen earnings predictions MSE energy/error-alignment identity and fee event forecast-realization gaps; no new forecast/calibration or feature/threshold selection.
stopping: One fixed eight-replay comparison. Preserve failures. No alternative window/cap/signal/fallback search after outcomes.
limitations: All price and financial history reused; not fresh holdout.
Retrospective corporate-action prices and assumed VIX availability retained.
Capping a shadow strategy is different from changing feedback in the original strategy.
No new data refresh, deployment, scheduler change or real orders.
